facts: On the northeast bank of the Potomac River, bordered by Maryland and Virginia
worth_knowing: A federal district that belongs to no state, created by the Residence Act of 1790. It is named for Columbia, a personification of the nation, and the capital moved here from Philadelphia in 1800.
